title: 第851章 天尊古尘殒命第850章 沈骆滨的怒斥
lines: 天尊古尘重伤之后，藏身于后方的孤寒城。
那里有最隐秘的防御阵法。
从来没有真正密不透风的墙。
魔主终于启用了这枚棋子。
曹利带着一批“残兵”进入孤寒城。
因为这些人看起来太惨了。
甚至不少人缺胳膊断腿。
曹利更是亲自跪在城门前。
“我等被魔兵一路追杀……至今才得以脱险......”
四周布满数十道防御阵纹。
他胸口的魔气，仍久久不散。
content_en:
After Tianzun Guchen was seriously injured, he hid in the lonely city behind.
There is the most secretive defensive formation there.
There are also heavy guards from Tiangang soldiers.
In theory.
No chance of leakage.
But in this world.
There are never truly airtight walls.
…
Cao Li, the official of heaven.
The former Heavenly Official of Lingsulfur City.
When Lingsulfur City was destroyed.
In order to survive, he surrendered to the devil.
And now.
The Demon Lord finally activated this chess piece.
Cao Li led a group of "remnants" into Guhan City.
No one doubted it.
Because these people look so miserable.
Covered in blood.
Armor shattered.
Many people even lacked arms and legs.
Cao Li personally knelt in front of the city gate.
Hoarse voice:
"The old department of Lingsulfur City...asking for help..."
"I was chased all the way by the demon soldiers...and I have only been able to escape until now..."
"Open the door quickly..."
The defenders let him go.
Because no one can imagine it.
Real knife.
Will poke someone from behind.
…
night.
Deep in Guhan City.
In the secret room.
Tianzun Guchen sat cross-legged.
There are dozens of defensive formations all around.
The spiritual energy is like a tide.
Constantly repairing his injuries.
But even so.
The demonic energy in his chest still lingered for a long time.
